product_brief: A complete redesign of Ethereum's consensus layer hardened for security, decentralization, and finality in seconds.
pqc_capability_description: Implements "Lean Cryptography" using hash-based signatures (XMSS) for post-quantum security. Includes leanSig (signature scheme) and leanMultisig (aggregation scheme). Devnets pq-devnet-0 through pq-devnet-4 have integrated leanSig/leanMultisig. Research tracks include hash-based multi-signatures replacing BLS and zkVM-optimized aggregation.
crypto_primitives: XMSS, BLS (current, being replaced), Poseidon (hash function), FRI, STU, WHIR (proof systems)
pqc_roadmap_details: pq-devnet-0 (Oct 25): No PQ sigs. pq-devnet-1 (Dec 25): Integrated leanSig. pq-devnet-2 (Jan 26): Integrated leanMultisig. pq-devnet-3 (Feb 26): Decoupled aggregation. pq-devnet-4 (Mar 26): Recursive PQ aggregation. pq-devnet-5 (Planned): Block-level aggregation proof, replace 3SF-mini with PQ heartbeat.
testing_&_validation_methods: Formal verification (Lean 4 framework for FRI, STU, WHIR), interoperability trials (Hive, multi-client coordination), performance benchmarking (leanBench)
